acceptanceCriteria: JT-AC-032: playback begins only through explicit user action and never resumes or migrates routes unexpectedly.
JT-TEST-029, JT-TEST-031, JT-TEST-033, and JT-TEST-041 cover default-level behavior, unexpected-playback prevention, route-change stop safety, and explicit post-interruption resumption.
Selection, profile changes, interruption, failure, and route change preserve a truthful stopped state until an explicit permitted restart.
notes: Planning complete for the deliberate-playback portion of SP-015. File an Issue for observed approved-requirement violations; do not broaden route policy or add background playback without explicit authorization.
Simulator state tests cannot establish actual route audibility, interruption behavior, or physical output; record those separately on hardware.
rationale: No-surprise playback and explicit restart behavior are hearing-safety critical across both platforms.
testSteps: Run JT-TEST-029, JT-TEST-031, JT-TEST-033, and JT-TEST-041 across supported iPhone and Watch lifecycle, selection, route, and interruption states.
Record starting playback state, selected pitch, route, interruption or route-change event, visible and accessibility-semantic state, and whether a subsequent explicit action is required.
Keep deterministic state-machine output separate from physical route and listening observations.

workItem.title: Qualify deliberate playback and route safety
